questions.q: If God is all-powerful, is there anything He still cannot do?
questions.answer: Yes. He can't lie or contradict Himself. That isn't weakness; it's because He is perfectly good and true. All-powerful means He can do everything that can be done.

questions.q: Why doesn't a God who can speak a universe into being just stop all evil?
questions.answer: The lesson says God gave us real free will, and He won't force us to choose good. He allows evil only for a time, for good reasons we only see in part right now.

questions.q: What good have you ever seen come out of something painful or hard?
questions.answer: One example: a parent's hard rule that felt awful at the time but turned out to protect me. The lesson says God can use even painful things for something good.
